dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many AWS‑Health specifics that a generic model would not know: support‑tier gating, mandatory us-east-1 endpoint, pagination limits (100 per page), throttling rate, exact EventBridge rule pattern, org‑view enablement flow, legacy statusCode mapping, deadline‑urgent note, and detailed edge‑case behaviours. The only missing delta is a few rare corner‑cases (e.g., handling pending org‑view status) so not a perfect 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides a concrete AWS‑specific procedure order (pre‑flight gate, entity pagination, status checks, org‑view validation, EventBridge rule verification) and embeds expert mindset (worst‑finding wins). Lacks a concrete exponential‑backoff algorithm for throttling, which prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with specific reasoning (e.g., never treat open issue with IMPAIRED as OK, never call Health API outside us-east-1, never assume delegated admin equals org‑view enabled). Misses a warning about missing IAM permissions for health:Describe* calls, so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description, when_to_use, activation_triggers, and invocation_schema are present and detailed. No concrete JSON example of the expected input payload, which would make activation deterministic; therefore one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document is heavily layered with sections, but the initial Mindset and Quick Reference sections are dense and contain many rules up front, causing cognitive overload. Critical rules are not hidden behind on‑demand links, leading to a moderate deduction.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by explicit confirmation prompts and read‑only API safety notes, matching the fragility of Health‑related operations. The only minor over‑constraint is requiring confirmation for every remediation even when the action is a harmless read‑only status check.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Process → Output → Edge Cases → Anti‑Patterns → Remediation), aiding comprehension. The ordering is slightly ad‑hoc (e.g., safety checks appear after remediation guidance), preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision trees, concrete CLI commands, error handling for malformed input, and worked examples that an agent could execute. Missing explicit handling of throttling exceptions and pagination edge‑cases in the example output, which could cause runtime failures.
